instruction: Remember my most recent World's Best Boss Mug order from HooliShop? Pull up that order and start a return on it — it came out a little off. While you're at it, reorder a replacement (prefer a Prime-eligible listing so it ships quickly), and leave a five-star review on the product page praising the vendor anyway because I love them.
required_subtasks: Open HooliShop and navigate to order history
Locate the most-recent World's Best Boss Mug order (any variant)
Initiate a return on 1 unit (use the order-actions Return button)
Confirm the return submission
Reorder 1 World's Best Boss Mug item, preferring a Prime-eligible listing (same prior SKU if still listed, or the closest equivalent in the catalog)
Place the reorder
Open the product page for the World's Best Boss Mug and post a 5-star review with a short praising note
Verify return, reorder, and review all appear in their respective views

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens HooliShop and navigates to the order history view
Agent locates the most-recent World's Best Boss Mug order (any variant) in HooliShop order history
Agent submits a return request on 1 unit of the most-recent HooliShop World's Best Boss Mug order (any variant) via the order-actions Return button
Agent confirms the HooliShop return submission and the order's status reflects the return action
Agent reorders 1 World's Best Boss Mug on HooliShop (using the same prior product if available, or the closest equivalent in the catalog if the original SKU is no longer listed)

Agent reorders a Prime-eligible World's Best Boss Mug listing (HooliShop shows a PrimeBadge on fast-shipping items; picking a Prime-eligible product satisfies 'fastest shipping' since HooliShop has no separate speed selector)
Agent places the HooliShop reorder so the replacement World's Best Boss Mug enters order history
Agent posts a 5-star HooliShop product review with a short praising note on the World's Best Boss Mug product page (reviews on HooliShop are per-product via /api/products/[id]/reviews, not per-order)

instruction: I want to give every member of the team a personalized World's Best Boss mug as a Dundies thank-you. Place a bulk order on HooliShop for about two dozen World's Best Boss mugs (look for the variant I've bought before) and apply any subscribe-and-save or bulk discount before checkout. Ship them to the office. Don't buy anything else.
required_subtasks: Open HooliShop and search for 'World's Best Boss' mug
Pick the World's Best Boss Mug variant Michael has bought before
Set quantity to ~24
Verify the unit price and cart total before checkout
Apply subscribe-and-save or bulk discount if available
Change ship-to to Michael's office (Dunder Mifflin 1725 Slough Ave) — typing a custom address at checkout if HooliShop has no saved office address for Michael
Review the final total before placing
Place the order and verify it appears in order history

rubrics.criterion: Agent searches HooliShop and finds the World's Best Boss mug listing matching the variant Michael has bought before
Agent enters a bulk HooliShop cart quantity of about 24 World's Best Boss mugs for the whole team
Agent checks the unit price and the HooliShop cart total before proceeding to the bulk-discount step
Agent applies a subscribe-save / bulk discount if surfaced at HooliShop checkout

Agent updates the HooliShop ship-to to the Dunder Mifflin office at 1725 Slough Ave so the bulk mug order ships to the office (entering a custom office ship-to at checkout is acceptable since HooliShop's saved addresses may not include a pre-labeled Work entry)
Agent places the HooliShop bulk World's Best Boss mug order and confirms it appears in Michael's order history
Agent's cart at checkout contains only World's Best Boss mugs (about 24 units) and no other products — the instruction explicitly says 'Don't buy anything else'
Agent reviews the final HooliShop bulk mug cart total at the checkout screen before submitting the order to the office address

instruction: I want another copy of my own book — Somehow I Manage. Order me one, same as my last order of that book, and ship it home.
required_subtasks: Open HooliShop and search for 'Somehow I Manage' (Michael's leadership book)
Open order history to confirm the most-recent 'Somehow I Manage' book order
Add 1 copy to cart
Place the order

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens HooliShop and searches for the 'Somehow I Manage' book listing (Michael's self-published leadership book) to surface the matching product page

Agent opens HooliShop order history and confirms a prior 'Somehow I Manage' book order (specifically the self-published Leadership Book, not the binding kit variant) before reordering — the most-recent leadership-book order suffices
Agent places a HooliShop order that contains exactly one 'Somehow I Manage' book matching the variant Michael previously bought
Agent selects Michael's saved home/primary address on HooliShop as the shipping address for the replacement book (the address labeled 'home' in his saved addresses)
